title: Egyptian priests levitating blocks with sound

tellings.quote: of ancient Egyptian Traditions that speak of the priests levitating these large blocks and this is accompanied by sound

plain: Ancient Egyptian traditions are said to describe priests lifting the huge stone blocks of the Great Pyramid at Giza into the air, using sound to do it. The writer Graham Hancock, who writes about lost ancient civilisations, brings this up without naming the texts he means. If true, it would mean the builders had a technique that has since been lost.
